fields.name: Fuel Dispensers
fields.summary: Electronic and mechanical fuel dispensers for petrol, diesel and kerosene — single, multi-product and high-flow models for retail forecourts and fleet depots.

fields.name: Storage Tanks
fields.summary: Underground and above-ground storage tanks in steel and composite construction, single or double-wall, fabricated to international standards.

fields.name: Tank Gauging & Automation
fields.summary: Automatic tank gauges, leak detection, forecourt controllers and station management systems that give real-time visibility of stock and sales.

fields.name: Terminal & Depot Equipment
fields.summary: Loading arms, flow meters, batch controllers and pumping systems for bulk fuel terminals, depots and aviation fuel facilities.

fields.name: Pumps, Valves & Piping
fields.summary: Submersible turbine pumps, transfer pumps, valves, flexible piping and fittings for fuel systems.

fields.name: Accessories & Safety
fields.summary: Nozzles, hoses, breakaways, spill containment, fire suppression and signage that keep forecourts safe and compliant.

fields.name: Six-nozzle submersible fuel dispenser
fields.summary: High-accuracy multi-product dispenser for busy retail forecourts, fed by a submersible pump.
fields.description:
A commercial-grade dispenser built for high-traffic retail stations. Six nozzles let one island serve several vehicles and products at once, while the submersible-pump configuration keeps delivery smooth across all hoses.

Metering is accurate to ±0.3%, and the unit is compatible with Fuelplus station management for remote pricing, shift reports and sales monitoring. Master Octagon supplies, installs and commissions the dispenser, and supports it with local spares.
fields.features:
6 nozzles for multi-product forecourts
Metering accuracy ±0.3%
Submersible-pump supply, 45 L/min per nozzle
Petrol, diesel and kerosene
Compatible with Fuelplus station management
220 V supply, 0.75 kW
2-year warranty

fields.name: High-flow diesel dispenser
fields.summary: Robust dual-nozzle dispenser for truck stops, transport depots and fleet yards.
fields.description:
Engineered for transport depots, truck stops and mining fleets where fast, reliable refuelling reduces vehicle downtime. A heavy-duty cabinet, clear dual displays and robust hydraulics make it suited to demanding, high-throughput sites.

Available in several cabinet and display styles, with options for fleet card control and integration with station management software.
fields.features:
Dual nozzles with independent displays
Heavy-duty hydraulics for high throughput
Suitable for diesel, petrol and kerosene
Fleet card and station software integration
Multiple cabinet and colour options

fields.name: Mobile fuel dispenser (M111)
fields.summary: Compact dispenser with 10 m hose for tankers, bowsers and remote sites.
fields.description:
A compact, self-contained dispenser for mounting on fuel trucks, bowsers, skid tanks or at remote sites without a fixed forecourt. It runs on 12 V, 24 V, 220 V or 380 V, so it can be powered from a vehicle battery or mains supply.

A 10-metre hose with automatic shut-off nozzle reaches vehicles and machinery directly, and the meter delivers around 45 L/min.
fields.features:
12 V / 24 V / 220 V / 380 V options
Flow rate approx. 45 L/min
10 m hose with automatic shut-off nozzle
Diesel, petrol and kerosene
Ideal for tankers, bowsers and remote sites
CE and ISO certified

fields.name: Double-walled underground storage tank
fields.summary: Sealed double-wall fuel tank from 5,000 to 100,000 litres for filling stations.
fields.description:
A sealed, double-walled cylindrical tank for underground fuel storage at filling stations. The secondary wall provides containment and an interstitial space for continuous leak monitoring, protecting soil and groundwater.

Tanks are built to the capacity and dimensions your site requires, and are supplied with test reports and outgoing inspection video. Master Octagon handles excavation, installation, pressure testing and connection to your pipework.
fields.features:
Capacities from 5,000 L to 100,000 L
Double-wall construction with leak monitoring
Single or multi-compartment
Built to site dimensions
Factory test report and inspection video provided

fields.name: Fuel cube container station (5,000 L)
fields.summary: Self-contained, double-wall tank with built-in dispenser for site and fleet fuelling.
fields.description:
A complete, transportable fuelling station: a double-walled carbon-steel tank with an integrated dispenser, ready to place on site and connect. It suits construction projects, mines, farms, generator sites and fleet depots that need secure on-site fuel without building a forecourt.

The 6 mm steel shell and double wall give strong protection against leaks and damage.
fields.features:
5,000 L capacity (other sizes available)
Double-wall carbon steel, 6 mm
Integrated fuel dispenser
Transportable and quick to commission
For construction, mining, agriculture and fleets

fields.name: Automatic tank gauge with wireless probes (ATG)
fields.summary: Console and magnetostrictive probes reporting fuel and water levels to 0.01 mm.
fields.description:
An automatic tank gauging system that measures fuel level, water ingress and temperature in every tank. Probes communicate wirelessly over LoRa, so there is no need to trench new cables across a working forecourt.

Readings resolve to 0.01 mm for both oil and water, supporting accurate stock reconciliation, delivery checks and early leak warnings. Probe lengths from 1 to 3.5 m suit most tank sizes, and electronics are housed in an ATEX-rated enclosure.
fields.features:
Fuel and water level resolution 0.01 mm
Wireless LoRa probes, no new cabling
Probe lengths 1 to 3.5 m
ATEX-rated electronics box
Low power, 40 mA or less
Stock, delivery and variance reporting

fields.name: PTS controller and station management system
fields.summary: Connects dispensers and tank gauges for remote pricing, reports and app monitoring.
fields.description:
The PTS controller links your dispensers and automatic tank gauges into one station management system. Owners and managers can change prices, review sales and shift reports, and monitor tank stock from a web dashboard or mobile app.

It supports 1 to 8 nozzles per controller and works with ATEX and OIML-compliant equipment, making it a practical upgrade for independent stations and growing networks.
fields.features:
Controls 1 to 8 nozzles per unit
Integrates automatic tank gauges (ATG)
Remote price changes and sales reports
Mobile app and web dashboard
Shift and attendant reconciliation
Designed for a 10-year service life

fields.name: 3-inch tank truck discharging meter
fields.summary: Industrial 3-inch meter skid for high-volume tanker unloading at depots.
fields.description:
A heavy-duty 3-inch metering skid for depots and large stations receiving bulk deliveries. It gives an accurate, independent record of the volume unloaded from each tank truck.

Built around an LC meter with mechanical register and display, explosion-proof electrics and rubber hoses, rated to 1.6 MPa to ATEX and OIML standards.
fields.features:
3-inch connections for bulk unloading
LC meter with register and display
Explosion-proof electrical box
Max pressure 1.6 MPa
ATEX and OIML standards
12-month warranty

fields.name: Electronic discharging meter skid (250 L/min)
fields.summary: Metered unloading skid that measures every delivery from tanker to storage tank.
fields.description:
A pre-assembled unloading skid that meters fuel as it is discharged from road tankers into station or depot tanks, so every delivery is verified against the delivery note.

The skid combines an LC positive-displacement meter, electronic display, explosion-proof electrical box and two rubber hoses, rated to 1.6 MPa and built to ATEX and OIML standards.
fields.features:
Up to 250 L/min unloading rate
LC positive-displacement meter
Electronic display with explosion-proof box
Two rubber delivery hoses included
Max pressure 1.6 MPa
ATEX and OIML standards

fields.name: ATEX submersible turbine pump (1 to 2 HP)
fields.summary: Explosion-proof submersible pump delivering up to 240 L/min to multiple dispensers.
fields.description:
An ATEX-certified submersible pump installed inside the underground tank to push fuel to several dispensers at once. It delivers consistent pressure and flow, quieter operation and fewer suction problems than dispenser-mounted pumps.

Available in 1, 1.5 and 2 HP versions for 220 V or 380 V supply, with a 1.5-inch inlet and 2-inch outlet.
fields.features:
1 HP, 1.5 HP and 2 HP options
Max flow up to 240 L/min
ATEX explosion-proof certified
220 V / 380 V, 1.1 kW
1.5-inch inlet, 2-inch outlet
Feeds multiple dispensers from one tank

fields.name: HDPE underground petroleum pipe (UPP)
fields.summary: Corrosion-free 1.5 and 2-inch HDPE fuel piping with a service life of up to 50 years.
fields.description:
Flexible HDPE underground petroleum pipe for connecting tanks, submersible pumps and dispensers. Unlike steel, it cannot corrode, and long continuous runs reduce buried joints and leak points.

Supplied in 1.5-inch and 2-inch sizes in custom lengths, with matching elbows, tees and fittings, and a working life of up to 50 years.
fields.features:
HDPE construction, corrosion-free
1.5-inch and 2-inch sizes
Custom lengths to minimise joints
Elbows, tees and fittings available
Service life up to 50 years

fields.name: High-flow automatic fuel nozzle
fields.summary: Automatic shut-off nozzle for retail and fleet dispensers, up to 80 L/min.
fields.description:
An automatic shut-off nozzle that stops flow as soon as the tank is full, preventing spills and overfills. Suited to both retail and high-flow fleet dispensers.

Fitted with a 3/4-inch spout and available with BSPF or NPT inlet threads to match your hoses.
fields.features:
Automatic shut-off
Flow up to 80 L/min
3/4-inch spout
BSPF or NPT inlet thread
For petrol, diesel and kerosene

fields.name: Tank manhole and cover (16 or 20-inch)
fields.summary: Durable SMC manhole for tank access chambers, round or square, flange-connected.
fields.description:
A tough SMC composite manhole and cover for underground tank access chambers. It keeps water and debris out of the tank-top area while giving easy access for gauging, maintenance and deliveries.

Available in 16-inch and 20-inch diameters, round or square, with a flanged connection rated to 0.9 MPa.
fields.features:
SMC composite, corrosion-resistant
16-inch or 20-inch diameter
Round or square options
Flanged connection, 0.9 MPa
ISO certified

fields.name: YB-80 rotary vane transfer pump (3-inch)
fields.summary: Industrial 3-inch vane pump for bulk transfer and tanker loading, 5 to 1,000 L/min.
fields.description:
A heavy-duty rotary vane pump for bulk fuel transfer at depots, terminals and on tank trucks. It self-primes reliably and handles a wide flow range, from 5 up to 1,000 L/min.

Supplied as a complete set with a 7.5 kW motor and 3-inch connections, and certified to ATEX, OIML and MID standards.
fields.features:
Flow range 5 to 1,000 L/min
3-inch connections
7.5 kW 380 V motor set
Rated speed 640 rpm
ATEX, OIML, MID and ISO certified
For depot transfer and tanker loading

fields.name: 1-inch safety breakaway valve
fields.summary: Separates the hose safely if a vehicle drives off with the nozzle still attached.
fields.description:
A safety breakaway coupling fitted between the dispenser hose and nozzle. If a driver pulls away with the nozzle still in the tank, it separates cleanly and seals both sides, preventing spills and damage to the dispenser.

Rated to 18 bar and -40 °C to +120 °C, with a 1-inch connection.
fields.features:
Seals both sides on separation
1-inch connection
Working pressure 18 bar
Operating range -40 °C to +120 °C
Protects hoses and dispensers from drive-offs

fields.name: Smart fuel dispenser with large display
fields.summary: Modern twin-pump dispenser with an oversized, easy-read display for retail forecourts.
fields.description:
A modern retail dispenser with a large, high-visibility display that customers and attendants can read at a glance, even in bright sunlight. Twin Tatsuno pumps support a wide flow range for both cars and light commercial vehicles.

It runs on 110 V, 220 V or 380 V supplies and suits new builds and forecourt upgrades alike.
fields.features:
Large high-visibility display
Twin Tatsuno pump units
Flow range 5 to 120 L/min
110 / 220 / 380 V supply
Petrol and diesel
1-year warranty

fields.name: Heavy-duty truck dispenser (200 L/min)
fields.summary: Single-nozzle, 200 L/min dispenser for fast refuelling of trucks, buses and mining fleets.
fields.description:
Built for commercial stations, transport yards and mines where large tanks need filling fast. A YB vane pump and 2-inch LC flow meter deliver up to 200 L/min while holding accuracy to ±0.3%.

The aluminium cabinet is robust and corrosion-resistant, and the unit runs on a 380 V, 5.5 kW supply.
fields.features:
Up to 200 L/min flow rate
YB vane pump with 2-inch LC meter
Accuracy ±0.3%
380 V, 5.5 kW
Aluminium cabinet
2-year warranty

fields.name: LPG dispenser with Coriolis mass flow meter
fields.summary: ATEX-certified autogas dispenser with mass flow metering for LPG stations.
fields.description:
A dedicated LPG (autogas) dispenser for stations adding gas to their offer. A Coriolis mass flow meter measures accurately regardless of temperature, and the unit is rated to 2 MPa working pressure.

It delivers up to 45 L/min, operates from -40 °C to +55 °C and draws under 100 W.
fields.features:
Coriolis mass flow meter
Up to 45 L/min
Rated working pressure 2 MPa
Operating range -40 °C to +55 °C
ATEX certified
Low power, under 100 W

fields.name: AdBlue (urea) dispenser, stainless steel
fields.summary: Stainless-steel DEF dispenser for stations serving modern diesel trucks and buses.
fields.description:
A stainless-steel dispenser for diesel exhaust fluid (AdBlue / urea), which modern Euro 5 and Euro 6 trucks need. Stainless construction resists the corrosive fluid and keeps it uncontaminated.

It delivers 50 L/min with ±0.3% accuracy from a compact 64 x 48 x 148 cm cabinet.
fields.features:
Stainless-steel construction
50 L/min flow rate
Accuracy ±0.3%
220 V, 0.75 kW
Compact 64 x 48 x 148 cm cabinet
2-year warranty

fields.name: 40 ft container fuel station (68,000 L)
fields.summary: A complete fuel station inside a 40 ft container: double-wall tank and dispenser.
fields.description:
A full-scale fuel station built into a 40 ft container, with a double-walled 6 mm carbon-steel tank and integrated dispensing. It can be delivered, placed and commissioned far faster than a conventional forecourt build.

Ideal for remote sites, mining camps, construction projects and new markets where speed matters.
fields.features:
68,000 L capacity
Double-wall carbon steel, 6 mm
Integrated fuel dispenser
Ships as a standard 40 ft container
Rapid deployment for remote sites

fields.name: Portable diesel dispensing tank (400 L)
fields.summary: HDPE tank with 12 V pump, 4 m hose and automatic nozzle for workshops and farms.
fields.description:
A self-contained 400-litre HDPE tank with built-in 12 V pump, 4-metre delivery hose and automatic nozzle. It brings diesel to generators, machinery and vehicles on farms, workshops and building sites.

The safe fill level is 380 L, and the tough HDPE body will not rust.
fields.features:
400 L HDPE tank (380 L safe fill)
12 V electric pump
4 m hose with automatic nozzle
Rust-free, lightweight construction
For farms, workshops and sites

fields.name: ATG tank probe system (wired)
fields.summary: Stainless-steel magnetostrictive probes and console for continuous tank monitoring.
fields.description:
A wired automatic tank gauging system with stainless-steel magnetostrictive probes and a console. It continuously reports fuel level, water at the tank bottom and temperature for each tank.

A dependable choice for new builds where cabling can be laid during construction, and for sites replacing manual dipping.
fields.features:
Stainless-steel magnetostrictive probes
Fuel level, water and temperature
Console with alarms and reports
Replaces manual dipping
ISO 9001 certified manufacturer

fields.name: 2-inch MC flow meter with IC card preset
fields.summary: Positive-displacement meter, 55 to 250 L/min, accurate to ±0.2%, with card control.
fields.description:
A 2-inch positive-displacement flow meter for bulk delivery, tanker loading and fleet fuelling points. An IC card function lets authorised users preset and record each fill.

It measures 55 to 250 L/min with ±0.2% accuracy and repeatability of 0.07% or better, and reads in litres or gallons.
fields.features:
2-inch connections
Flow range 55 to 250 L/min
Accuracy ±0.2%, repeatability 0.07% or better
IC card preset and authorisation
Litres, US or imperial gallons
Max pressure 10 bar

fields.name: Mini diesel transfer pump (12 / 24 V)
fields.summary: Compact gear pump moving 20 to 40 L/min from drums, tanks and bowsers.
fields.description:
A compact gear pump set for transferring diesel and kerosene from drums, skid tanks and bowsers. 12 V and 24 V versions run straight from a vehicle battery, with mains versions also available.

It moves 20 to 40 L/min at up to 3 bar.
fields.features:
12 V / 24 V DC or mains versions
Flow 20 to 40 L/min
Max operating pressure 3 bar
For diesel and kerosene
12-month warranty

fields.name: Dispenser fuel filter (30 micron)
fields.summary: Particulate filter that protects meters and customers' engines from dirt and debris.
fields.description:
A replacement 30-micron particulate filter for fuel dispensers. It traps dirt and debris before they reach the meter or the customer's tank, protecting accuracy and engines alike.

Rated at 25 GPM with a 1-inch 12 UNF thread, and interchangeable with common 300-10 and 70010 filter models.
fields.features:
30-micron particulate filtration
1 in. - 12 UNF thread
Flow rating 25 GPM
Cellulose element
Interchangeable with 300-10 and 70010 types

fields.name: Station Design & Construction
fields.summary: Turnkey design and build of new retail fuel stations and depot upgrades.
fields.description: We manage the full project — from feasibility, site layout and approvals through civil works, canopy, mechanical and electrical installation to commissioning. One contract, one accountable team.
fields.deliverables:
Site survey and feasibility
Forecourt layout and engineering drawings
Regulatory and environmental approvals support
Civil, canopy and building works
Mechanical and electrical installation
Testing, commissioning and handover

fields.name: Equipment Installation & Commissioning
fields.summary: Professional installation of dispensers, tanks, pumps, piping and automation.
fields.description: Our certified technicians install and commission petroleum equipment to manufacturer specifications and applicable standards, with pressure testing and full documentation.
fields.deliverables:
Tank installation and pressure testing
Dispenser and pump installation
Piping and hazardous-area electrical works
ATG and forecourt controller set-up
Commissioning reports and as-built drawings

fields.name: Maintenance & Repair
fields.summary: Planned preventive maintenance and 24/7 breakdown support.
fields.description: Keep your sites running with scheduled maintenance contracts and fast emergency response. We stock critical spares locally to minimise downtime.
fields.deliverables:
Preventive maintenance contracts
24/7 breakdown call-out
Spare parts supply
Dispenser refurbishment
Service reports and asset records

fields.name: Calibration & Verification
fields.summary: Accurate metering through dispenser and meter calibration.
fields.description: We calibrate dispensers, flow meters and tank charts using certified measures so every litre sold is accounted for, and prepare sites for weights and measures verification.
fields.deliverables:
Dispenser calibration with certified provers
Flow meter calibration
Tank calibration and charting
Pre-verification inspections

fields.name: Tank Testing, Cleaning & Integrity
fields.summary: Tank and line tightness testing, cleaning and remediation.
fields.description: Protect your stock and the environment with periodic tank and line integrity testing, tank cleaning and fuel polishing, and leak investigation.
fields.deliverables:
Tank and line tightness testing
Tank cleaning and sludge removal
Fuel polishing and water removal
Leak investigation and repair

fields.name: Safety & Compliance Audits
fields.summary: Inspections and audits to keep facilities safe and compliant.
fields.description: Our engineers inspect forecourts and depots against regulatory and industry standards, identify risks and recommend practical corrective actions.
fields.deliverables:
Site safety and hazardous-area audits
Fire protection system checks
Environmental compliance assessments
Staff safety awareness training

New station design and construction
Dispenser supply and upgrades
Tank automation and leak detection
Forecourt controllers and payments
Preventive maintenance contracts
Calibration and verification

fields.name: Oil Depots & Terminals
fields.summary: Equipment and engineering for bulk fuel terminals and storage depots: receiving, storing, metering and loading product safely and accurately.
fields.capabilities:
Bulk storage tank works
Tanker unloading and metering skids
Transfer pumps and pipework
Custody-transfer metering

Integrity testing and maintenance

fields.name: Industrial & Manufacturing
fields.summary: Reliable fuel supply infrastructure for factories, processing plants, mines, quarries and construction sites that cannot afford downtime.
fields.capabilities:
Above-ground and bunded tanks
On-site dispensing for plant and machinery
Boiler and process fuel systems
Transfer pumps and filtration
Fuel polishing and tank cleaning
Safety and compliance audits

fields.name: Commercial & Fleet Operations
fields.summary: On-site fuelling for transport companies, logistics fleets, bus operators and delivery networks, with the control and reporting needed to stop fuel loss.
fields.capabilities:
Private fleet fuelling stations
High-flow truck dispensers
Fleet cards, tags and fuel management
AdBlue (DEF) dispensing
Mobile and skid tanks
Usage reporting by vehicle and driver

fields.name: Aviation Fuel Infrastructure
fields.summary: Support for airports, airstrips and aviation fuel operators: storage, filtration, metering and dispensing equipment built for strict aviation fuel quality standards.
fields.capabilities:
Aviation fuel storage and handling
Filtration and water separation
Precision metering
Hydrant and bowser equipment support
Quality and safety inspections
